data.gender_notes: Musaddiqa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A woman named Musaddiqa is one who continually seeks the truth. This name is derived from the Arabic word ‘musaddiq’ which means ‘one who confirms or authenticates.’ In Islamic tradition, Musaddiqa is a title given to the virtuous wife of Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham). The name Musaddiqa carries the meaning “Seeker of truth” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Musaddiqa usually hope their child will grow to embody seeker of truth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
